intro: Pulla Reddy Institute of Pharmacy is in Hyderabad and St Peter's Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences is in Hanamkonda. This page compares their recorded B.Pharm fees, placements, admission routes and campuses for 2026.

Pulla Reddy Institute of Pharmacy vs St Peter's Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: Pulla Reddy Institute of Pharmacy vs St Peter's Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences for B.Pharm: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Pulla Reddy Institute of Pharmacy if its B.Pharm programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.
Choose St Peter's Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹60,000 a year as tuition fees for Pulla Reddy Institute of Pharmacy's Bachelor of Pharmacy. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹38,000 a year as tuition fees for St Peter's Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences's Bachelor of Pharmacy. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for Pulla Reddy Institute of Pharmacy on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.

In our records, St Peter's Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh for Bachelor of Pharmacy. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Pulla Reddy Institute of Pharmacy's recorded admission tests on this page include TS EAPCET.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for St Peter's Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences on this B.Pharm page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Pulla Reddy Institute of Pharmacy is recorded in Hyderabad, Telangana, and St Peter's Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences is in Hanamkonda, Telangana.
If you have a strong city preference, let that lead, then compare fees and the admission test for the same programme.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: There is no universal winner in Pulla Reddy Institute of Pharmacy vs St Peter's Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences for B.Pharm. Use the programme list, the official fee notice and the admission test to decide.
If one side is missing a quotable fee or a recent official placement year, do not fill the gap with a guess from another course or an older batch.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
